description: This Java class 'ObjectMapperFactory' provides a static method to create and configure a singleton Jackson ObjectMapper with specific settings for JSON serialization and deserialization, including handling of comments, case insensitivity, and omission of default/null/empty values.

classes.name: ObjectMapperFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating a singleton configured Jackson ObjectMapper.

methods.name: createObjectMapper
methods.description: Creates and configures a singleton ObjectMapper with custom settings for JSON processing.
